why: The new examples caused the model to stop cutting inside tightly bound name/title packages and to preserve list/quantifier frames and preverbal predicate chunks — e.g. it now joins “Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich” and keeps list cores together. That shift moved many cuts away from names and clause cores into adjacent very short pieces (≤3 and ≤5-word bins), increasing bad short-fragment splits enough to lower the overall H_set despite improvements on longer pieces.
lesson: Preserving multiword names and list/clause cores helps longer pieces but can force harmful ultra-short fragments; future edits should avoid moving cuts in a way that produces many ≤3-word pieces.
